influences.name: Andre Kostelanetz
influences.context: Musically the song was influenced by the chord progression and arrangement by conductor Andre Kostelanetz's version of the orchestral piece the Grand Canyon Suite

influences.name: Felice and Boudleaux Bryant
influences.context: The early hits for the brothers came via the songwriting powerhouse of Felice and Boudleaux Bryant, the New-Orleans-based husband and wife team who wrote the Everlys first six hit songs between 1956-58

influences.name: old-time country music
influences.context: They also brought sensitivity, the result of their having been weaned on old-time country music.
